trial_title: Effect of Sotagliflozin on Cardiovascular and Renal Events in Participants With Type 2 Diabetes and Moderate Renal Impairment Who Are at Cardiovascular Risk

patient.summary: 46 years old at screening, recorded sex male, died 2026-05-03, after this screening

absence_policy.note: coverage-gated, meaning a finding absent from the chart counts as absent only where an encounter documents the window

criteria.quote: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus with glycosylated hemoglobin (HbA1c) ≥7%.
criteria.rationale: type 2 diabetes mellitus is documented (Condition/1be83f06-48ef-7bac-29c9-3bb8d314aa2b: Diabetes mellitus type 2 (disorder) (active, confirmed) (2025-06-03)) and 7.58 % on 2025-06-03 against >= 7.0 %

criteria.quote: Estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) ≥25 and ≤60 milliliter/minute (mL/min)/1.73 square meter (m^2).
criteria.rationale: 141.3 mL/min/{1.73_m2} on 2025-06-03 against between 25.0 and 60.0 mL/min/{1.73_m2}

criteria.quote: Age 18 years or older with at least one major cardiovascular risk factor or age 55 years or older with at least two minor cardiovascular risk factors.
criteria.rationale: this criterion was not formalised because it cannot be decided from data

resolution.missing: human judgement: the criterion counts major and minor cardiovascular risk factors without listing either, so neither branch names anything countable

criteria.rationale: this criterion is settled at the screening visit, not from the record

resolution.missing: confirmation at the screening visit: consent is a site procedure and leaves no finding in the patient record

criteria.quote: Antihyperglycemic treatment has not been stable within 12 weeks prior to screening.
criteria.rationale: this criterion was not formalised because it cannot be decided from data

resolution.missing: human judgement: the chart records prescriptions, not whether antihyperglycaemic therapy was unchanged over the 12 weeks before screening

criteria.quote: Planned coronary procedure or surgery after randomization.
criteria.rationale: this criterion is settled at the screening visit, not from the record

resolution.missing: confirmation at the screening visit: a planned procedure is an intention, and the chart records events

criteria.quote: Lower extremity complications (such as skin ulcer, infection, osteomyelitis, and gangrene) identified during screening and requiring treatment at randomization.
criteria.rationale: this criterion was not formalised because it cannot be decided from data

resolution.missing: human judgement: 'such as' leaves the list of lower extremity complications open, and the criterion turns on treatment being required at randomisation, which has not happened when a chart is screened

criteria.quote: Planning to start a sodium-glucose linked transporter-2 (SGLT2) inhibitor during the study.
criteria.rationale: this criterion is settled at the screening visit, not from the record

resolution.missing: confirmation at the screening visit: starting a drug during the study is an intention, and the chart records events
